system.description:
Structures of jade-magnetite alloy in the walls let the manse control elemental Essence outside itself. In one five-tick span it can affect a volume of its element equal to its rating in yards, cubed (for Fire, square yards of surface area). Non-magical quantities of that element within that size restriction cannot harm the manse; against magical instances or amounts greater than it can control, all damage is reduced by (manse's rating x 2) dice. It can also move the element at three yards per tick.

During any five-tick span the manse can direct one instance of the element to act on a target within (manse's rating) yards, using a dice pool equal to (manse's rating x 2); any result it produces equals the manse's rating plus successes. Using this power the manse can issue a feat of strength equal to (rating x 2), or with a successful roll impose a penalty equal to its rating on a target's roll. The manse can cause diverse, imprecise effects so long as they do not create, destroy or fundamentally alter the element. More powerful manses perform more impressive feats.
